info.title: Memoria Public API
info.description: Architecture contract. No HTTP endpoint is implemented in this session. File upload, view/filter and property-management routes are specified at module implementation time. All POST routes require Idempotency-Key; writes to existing page aggregates require If-Match. Error format is shared across /v1.

200.description: Authorized results; permissions applied before pagination

401.description: Missing, expired or revoked API key

403.description: Insufficient scope, page grant or authentication assurance

409.description: Idempotency key reused with another request, or operation still in progress

412.description: If-Match does not match current page version

422.description: Unsupported block type/version or invalid property value

post.description: All writes go through BlockWriteService. If-Match is the parent page ETag. The entire batch fails on conflict; no partial changes. Current permission checks precede idempotency replay.
